title: PutBlobResponse
description: Source of truth: the BlobStore filesystem (byte-CID-keyed, Category C operational) and the DNA-notarized ShardManifest. Response from PUT /blob/{cid}. Declares the byte CID the bytes were stored under and the full byte profile that produced the representation (chunker and erasure parameters) so a reader never consults current thresholds. `stripes` is empty when `profile.erasure.id` is "none"; with `rs-gf8-0x11d-v1` each stripe covers at most 16 MiB of original bytes as data+parity shards. Address strings are CIDv1 base32 (byte CID: raw 0x55 + blake3-256 0x1e, prefix `bafkr4i`); readers fully decode (elohim-address).

blobCid.description: Byte CID of the stored bytes.

byteLen.description: Exact byte length the blobCid commits to.

profile.description: The byte profile this representation was produced under. Readers use these recorded parameters, never the server's current thresholds.

epoch.description: Byte-profile epoch. An unknown epoch is HELD by the reader.

chunks.description: Content-defined chunks in order; each chunk is itself a byte CID. Empty for an empty blob.

stripes.description: Erasure stripes in order (empty when erasure id is "none"). Each stripe lists its data then parity shards by index.

byteCid.description: raw (0x55) + blake3-256 (0x1e); the pattern is a syntactic floor — readers fully decode (elohim-address)
